name: Relay reset coil
summary: A reset coil releases or changes the retained state of its associated latching relay.
description: A reset coil releases or changes the retained state of its associated latching relay. The shared device identity links this coil to the latch mechanism and contacts elsewhere on the schematic.
readingNotes: Trace the reset command to the specific retained device.
